project_type: Python FastAPI Enterprise Document Management System
test_framework: pytest-asyncio with SQLite in-memory fixture via conftest.py, httpx AsyncClient for API tests
build_command: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' for linting. 2. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -x -q' for all tests (current baseline: 481 passing). 3. Verify new endpoints respond correctly.
setup_instructions: uv sync to install dependencies. Tests use SQLite fixture - no external DB needed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Python 3.11.14 via pyenv. No Docker daemon needed for tests. LLM calls are mocked/stubbed in tests.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: models inherit Base from app/models/group.py, routers use APIRouter registered in app/api/router.py, auth via get_current_user/require_permission/require_role from app/core/security.py, schemas in app/schemas/, services in app/services/
key_patterns: UUID primary keys for non-document models. Document IDs are integers. Notification via NotificationManager singleton with WebSocket. SecurityAlert model for security events. OrgChangeHistory for audit trail pattern. EnvelopeEncryption for per-file DEK wrapped by KEK. KMSProvider ABC with LocalFileKMS/VaultKMS/CosmianKMS. Config via pydantic-settings Settings class. Background tasks via FastAPI BackgroundTasks. Tests use pytest_asyncio fixtures with db_session and client fixtures from conftest.py.
directory_structure: app/api/ - FastAPI routers, app/core/ - config/db/security/llm, app/models/ - SQLAlchemy models (Base from group.py), app/schemas/ - Pydantic response/request models, app/services/ - business logic services, app/templates/ - Jinja2 HTML templates, tests/ - pytest test files, docs/ - documentation markdown
